about: Shared Swift/Rust Hermes YAML setup cases. Compare parsed settings and all other server definitions, plus exact text where ordinary block YAML can be retained. Never mutate invalid YAML.

cases.name: comments-only placeholder
cases.existing: # Hermes settings are not filled yet
contains: # Hermes settings are not filled yet

cases.name: existing settings without servers
cases.existing:
# Hermes settings
model:
  provider: nous
  name: hermes

cases.name: preserve other server and comments
cases.existing:
# Hermes
model: "chosen" # do not change
mcp_servers:
  # Other server
  files:
    command: "other"
    args: ["a", "b"] # preserve
# Following setting
terminal:
  cwd: "/work"
contains:
# Other server
  files:
    command: "other"
    args: ["a", "b"] # preserve

cases.name: renew only our key
cases.existing:
mcp_servers:
  files:
    command: other
    env:
      TORROMAIL_TOKEN: decoy
  torromail:
    command: old
    env:
      TORROMAIL_TOKEN: old_key
  # Keep next server
  last:
    command: last
model: hermes
contains:
# Keep next server
  last:
    command: last

cases.name: anchors across sections
cases.existing:
defaults: &defaults {command: other, args: [one]}
mcp_servers:
  other: *defaults
model: hermes

cases.name: disconnect only our server
cases.existing:
mcp_servers:
  torromail:
    command: old
    env:
      TORROMAIL_TOKEN: old_key
  # Other server
  other:
    command: keep
model: hermes
